basis: Viewed all six ordered source sequences before reading current model outputs. Source-reviewed v4 remains frozen. Scene labels below are audit-only and never sent to subjects.

cases.vfp_active_001: Cream and pale-blue figures progressively increase in displayed size at essentially fixed horizontal centers. Small light prop, ground line and navy-to-teal background hold. The sequence does not establish a camera push, a cut, gestures or narrative action. Tone adjectives are interpretation.
cases.vfp_active_002: Coral figure and red rectangular prop translate left to right against a fixed red field with diagonal lines and an outlined angular motif. The lined backdrop does not visibly whip-pan.
cases.vfp_active_003: Five exact repeated frames. Muted dark field, warm circular object on a stem at left, gray-blue elongated rectangular shape, warm figure at right. Reading the shapes as a lamp and bed is plausible. No observable movement.
cases.vfp_active_004: Fixed camera-like composition of a brown platform against a dark field. Small rectangle at the same position is red at zero-based frames 0–1, blue at 2–4. This is the authored visual continuity break; physical cause is unobservable.
cases.vfp_active_005: Yellow figure with attached yellow prop moves from left to right in an upward then downward arc over a dark platform gap. Background diagonal lines, gap and horizon persist; no definite crash zoom.
cases.vfp_active_006: Cyan figure with a pale cyan prop translates laterally from left to right under a fixed arch. Distinct diagonal lines show changing background pattern; source does not establish physical rain or a camera tracking mechanism.
